skills.name: Orbital Combo
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Ether DMG.
The fifth attack is a Whim, conjuring an Ethereal figure that inflicts Ether DMG on enemies in a circular area ahead. When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Whim.

skills.name: Fading Silhouette
skills.desc:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Refraction
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.name: Stardust Echo
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
This Dodge Counter is a Whim. When activated, summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG. If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Crushing Mist
skills.desc:
When the active character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
This Quick Assist is a Whim. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG. If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Voice of Illusory Dreams
skills.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Harmony of Painted Dreams
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
This Assist Follow-Up is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG. If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
skills.desc:
Press [Special Attack] to activate: This Special Attack is a Whim. When activated, it recreates an Ethereal figure that slashes forward in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

skills.name: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
skills.desc:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
This EX Special Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing Ether DMG. When Lucia uses any Harmony, all squad members gain the Darkbreaker state. While in Darkbreaker state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional 5.2 Sheer Force. The Darkbreaker state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of 636, lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any Harmony deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional 37% of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the Dream state and under the effect of Ether Veil: Wellspring, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her Basic Attack. If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 60 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
*Stats shown are at Base level.

skills.name: Stage of Brilliance
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
This Chain Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that pulls in enemies in a circular area ahead and deals Ether DMG. If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Charge, Great Armor!
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
This Ultimate is a Harmony. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Ether DMG. A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence. Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to 1.05% of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the Dream state and Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 100 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. If she is in the Dream state when activating this Harmony, she will gain 100 Dream Points and re-enter Dream state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked. Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

skills.name: Lost Nocturne
skills.desc:
When entering the battlefield, Lucia immediately gains 60 Dream Points. If her Dream Points reaches 100 upon activating a Whim or Harmony, she enters the Dream state.
When entering the Dream state, it triggers a Quick Assist and simultaneously activates Ether Veil: Wellspring. While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a max of 300s.
While Lucia is in the Dream state, using any Whim consumes 25 Dream Points and upgrades it to Harmony. Whenever another active character's attack hits an enemy, Lucia consumes 25 Dream Points to unleash an Aftershock. This Aftershock is a Harmony. After Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or Aftershock, Aftershock cannot be triggered for 8s.
When Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or an Aftershock, all squad members gain the Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme state. While in Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme state, DMG dealt increases by 10% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Lucia runs out of Dream Points or she leaves the Ether Veil, she exits the Dream state.
rows: Squad DMG Increases during Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme state

skills.name: Ballad of the Long Night
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad is a Rupture or Stun character:
When applying Darkbreaker, additionally applies a 30% CRIT DMG increase effect.

cons.name: Secret Friend
cons.desc:
When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme deals additional DMG, ignore 18% of enemy All-Attribute RES and have 5% increased Decibel Generation Rate.
Each time Lucia performs a skill upgrade, she gains 1 stack of Echo, stacking up to 4 times. When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme ends, if Lucia has any Echo stacks, 1 stack is consumed to reapply Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme to all squad members.

cons.name: Great Magician
cons.desc:
While Lucia is inside Ether Veil: Wellspring, Harmony deals 15% more DMG.
Agents in the Darkbreaker state gain an additional 15% Sheer DMG increase while in Ether Veil: Wellspring.

cons.name: The Best Partner
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Late-Night Hours
cons.desc: When Ether Veil is activated or extended on the field, Lucia grants all squad members 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

cons.name: Dream Watcher
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: The Never-Ending Journey
cons.desc: When Lucia is inside any Ether Veil, her ATK increases by 2% of her initial Max HP, and Harmony always triggers a CRIT with Harmony CRIT DMG increased by 30%.
